# Pinned local QR encoder

- Dependency: `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT.
- Published package metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/1.4.4
- Unmodified source: https://unpkg.com/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js
- Exact source size: 56,694 bytes.
- SHA-256 (base64): `GK45n4EYK8nekW6cd7GV3yDMWNby1VpisIWimfG/F4A=`.
- Distribution file integrity independently listed at https://unpkg.com/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/?meta .

The package's source header explicitly identifies MIT and copyright (c) 2009
Kazuhiko Arase; the npm archive does not contain a separate LICENSE file.
The accompanying license file retains that attribution and the standard MIT
permission/warranty text. The build also includes this text in its output.

Only addData/make/getModuleCount/isDark are used to render local SVG geometry.
No external QR URL service, network API, eval, browser persistence, image URL,
second React copy, npm installation, or transitive dependencies are used.
The unused image/SVG/ASCII helper methods remain unchanged for reproducible
upstream integrity; no upstream source is executed during the build itself.
